news.title: Hezbollah acquires the pagers from the intermediary and distributes them to members
news.subtitle: Distribution period up to September 2024 (reported)
news.description: According to multiple news organisations, Hezbollah purchased the pagers through the intermediary company and distributed thousands of units to operatives (the devices were attractive because pagers avoid cell-phone vulnerabilities). Hezbollah later instructed cadres to use pagers rather than cell phones. The devices reportedly circulated widely inside Hezbollah areas in Lebanon and some in Syria
